Según Expansión, el español sucederá a Christine Lagarde al frente del banco central el próximo 7 de febrero a falta de cerrar los últimos pasos del proceso con el Parlamento Europeo y el propio BCE. stories.narrEn: The Guardian reports: Former Bank of Spain governor chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde after winning support of EU’s biggest countries Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos has been chosen as the next president of the European Central Bank, to succeed Christine Lagarde, after winning support from the EU’s biggest countries. Bloomberg reports: Pablo Hernandez de Cos will become European Central Bank’s next president, directing the region’s fight against inflation and possible bond turmoil. According to Euronews, eurozone leaders meeting in Brussels backed Hernández de Cos to lead the European Central Bank, which sets interest rates for the 21 countries that use the euro. stories.headline: Marie-Antoinette’s porcelain ‘nipple bowl’ fetches record $3.1 million at Paris auction
stories.headlineEn: Marie-Antoinette’s porcelain ‘nipple bowl’ fetches record $3.1 million at Paris auction
stories.summaryEn: A "jatte-teton", or nipple bowl, that once belonged to French Queen Marie-Antoinette fetched a record €2.9 million ($3.1 million) at Paris auction Thursday. The breast-shaped porcelain bowl was one of four such pieces which King Louis XVI once ordered for his queen's royal dairy creamery.

stories.narrEn: France 24 reports: A "jatte-teton", or nipple bowl, that once belonged to French Queen Marie-Antoinette fetched a record €2.9 million ($3.1 million) at Paris auction Thursday. Le Monde reports: Commissioned by Louis XVI on the eve of the Revolution, the porcelain piece has fetched more than any other Sèvres work in auction history.
